name: Poison (Lethal)
description: As an action, you can use the poison in this vial to coat one vibroweapon, one slug cartridge, or one wrist launcher dart. A creature hit by the poisoned weapon must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 10d4 poison damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. Once applied, the poison retains potency for 1 minute before drying.
